subject: English
question_text: The graph below shows literacy rate from 1995 to 2010.
stimulus: Now describe the graph in 150 words. You should highlight and summarize the information given in the graph. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart represents the percentage of the types of books in a certain school library. From this pie chart we may see that there are 40% literary books which are available in the school library. There are 25% science subjects which are kept in the library. 20% Mathematics books are also kept in the library for the students. 15% other books are available in that library. Most of the books of the library are literary books. In this way the pie chart focuses on the different kinds of books which are available in the school library for the welfare of the students. One the whole, the pie chart shows the percentage of the types of books in a school library.

subject: English
question_text: Suppose, you are Shimla living in Sunamgonj, Bangladesh.
stimulus: Your pen-friend Edward, from Australia, wanted to know about the foods and food habits of the people of Bangladesh. Now write an email to her describing the foods and food habits of the people of Bangladesh. 10
guide_solution: Letter writing Dear Naz, Hope you are well. I am well but mentally upset can't physically. In your last letter, you wanted to know about my feelings , emotion , as well as experience bearing a student of my school, as I have to leave this deer place Just after few 158 days. I think you know that I have studied almost eight years in my present school. A lot of beautiful recollections still exist in my mind. Many good and helpful friends of mine are here that I never want to leave. My teacher are also very friendly to me. They love me with their offspring. But the reality is that I must leave this place that I never think, Since my father has recently transferred from here to Khulna. I am very unhappy as this situation is unavoidable very painful to me. I do not know how I remove my agony. No more today. With best regard to you and love to all. Your ever Shaz.
